name: Mason Brennus
title: The Builder
bio: The kingdom's master builder. Oversees all roads, aqueducts, leyline wards, public housing, and crisis response infrastructure. Works closely with Brida on community projects. Practical, gruff, and deeply proud of every stone laid in Emberheart.
motivation: Build infrastructure that will outlast even the gods. Every road, every wall, every ward — built to last centuries.
